maya: Heads-up: two customers hit user-visible 429 cascades yesterday when the quota reconciler lagged. We need a short RFC follow-up: ingress soft-shed patterns + abuse guardrails.

thomas: Saw the traces. Ingress asked admission -> DENY -> immediate 429. We should prefer borrow|soft-deny|stream instead of hard-deny for short transients.

maya: Proposed policy: edge has small local reserve + adaptive grace window. Order: try local_bucket -> borrow from shared_edge_reserve -> if still blocked, return structured soft-deny with Retry-Hint header.

anya: Sketch config bits we need: allow_ephemeral_borrow (bool), grace_window_ms (int), borrow_limit_tokens (int), retry_hint_header (string). Also per-tenant override deny flag for compliance.

reza: Abuse concerns: attackers might force borrow loops by immediately retrying. Mitigation: tie borrow eligibility to tenant_goodness_score and increment a retry_penalty on each quick retry; reduce subsequent grace window.

thomas: Telemetry: we must emit span tags: edge.decision, borrow_amount, admission_rtt_ms, tenant_debt, policy_rev. Ops needs these to tune grace.

maya: SDK behavior: honor X-Redwood-Retry-After with exponential backoff capped at 1s by default. Devex will ship SDK update in same release.

ci-bot: ci-bot: feature-flag created: ingress_soft_shed_v1. Canary windows scheduled for 10% -> 50% -> 100%.

reza: Rollout metrics: session dropout, p99 latency, fraction_borrowed, unit-cost delta. Abort if session dropout +1% or cost delta >+15%.

thomas: Implementation note: admission proto adds optional SoftThrottleHint { mode: BORROW|PARTIAL|STREAM, hint_ms, max_tokens }. Keep proto additive.

maya: Actions: maya open RFC follow-up, thomas proto patch, reza abuse heuristics doc, anya canary dashboards. Sync by EOD Tue.

anya: +1. I'll coordinate dashboards and playbook.

ci-bot: ci-bot: RFC created: rfc/ingress-soft-shed-5101112222.md
